tool.name: run_rule_classification
tool.description: 使用三个精确 Data version 对完整表格执行可审计的规则分类：数据表、包含类别顺序/开闭或多区间边界/来源/核验状态的规则 JSON，以及 indicator 到 field/unit/basis 的绑定 JSON。只有 VERIFIED 规则参与；缺测、非数值、超范围、规则空隙或未核验规则都保留为未评价，不自动换算单位，也不编造或近似规则。

semantics.description: The full staged input table with one-based row identity, overall class code/label/order, evaluation status and machine-readable not evaluated reason/details appended without changing source values.
limitations: An overall class exists only when every declared indicator is evaluated; otherwise the row remains not evaluated with indicator-level reasons.
The worst-class-order convention is deterministic aggregation, not scientific validation, regulatory approval or evidence that the supplied rules apply to this population.
semantics.source: workflow-declared data, rules and bindings versions

semantics.description: Long-form row-by-indicator results retaining observed numeric/text values, field, unit, basis, class, verification status, exact rule source identity and not evaluated reason.
semantics.grain: one row per input row and declared indicator
limitations: UNVERIFIED, WITHDRAWN and SUPERSEDED rules never produce a class; their rows remain not evaluated with RULE_NOT_VERIFIED.
Missing, non-numeric, non-finite, out-of-range and uncovered boundary values remain explicit rather than being imputed or forced into the nearest class.
semantics.source: workflow-declared rules and bindings versions; exact rule source fields are repeated per indicator

semantics.description: Flattened audit table for every explicit open/closed interval, including multi-interval classes, class order, indicator, bound field/unit/basis, verification status and source id/title/version/locator.
semantics.grain: one row per declared indicator interval
limitations: Presence in this table records what was supplied and applied; it is not scientific validation of the source, thresholds or decision context.
Disjoint multi-interval bounds can represent two-sided indicators such as pH without substituting an approximate one-sided rule.
semantics.source: exact workflow rules and bindings versions

semantics.description: Audit summary of full staged input scope, rule-set identity, evaluated/not evaluated counts, class counts, indicator reasons, verification statuses and interval/aggregation conventions.
limitations: Exact unit and basis equality is required and there is no unit conversion or semantic inference.
Classification does not establish measurement quality, sampling representativeness, causal interpretation, regulatory compliance or decision suitability.
